_note: Crystals available in the Wand Lab. drain = charge cost per projectile it touches; heat = Heat added per shot. Modifier numbers are at Clear quality; quality.strength scales the bonus part of each effect.

crystals.name: Fire
crystals.text: Fast burning bolt; ignites

crystals.name: Water
crystals.text: Heavy stream; knockback, soaks targets

crystals.name: Earth
crystals.text: Slow heavy shard; breaks armor

crystals.name: Wind
crystals.text: Fastest; pierces and pushes

crystals.name: Sunstone
crystals.text: +40% power

crystals.name: Twinspar
crystals.text: Fires 2 projectiles. Before other crystals: each copy gets them at full cost. After: splits the finished shot

crystals.name: Prismite
crystals.text: Fan of 3 (5 when Flawless); next to Wind widens to a 120° cone

crystals.name: Echo Opal
crystals.text: Repeats the shot 0.5 s later at 60%

crystals.name: Seedstone
crystals.text: On impact, bursts into 4 seedlings carrying the shot's elements

crystals.name: Swiftquartz
crystals.text: +60% speed; at the tip also +1 pierce

crystals.name: Lancet Spinel
crystals.text: Pierces through 2 targets; after Fire, each pierce spreads the burn

crystals.name: Ricochet Beryl
crystals.text: Bounces off walls 3 times; after Earth, +15% power per bounce

crystals.name: Seeker's Eye Agate
crystals.text: Homes on targets; before a multiplier, copies pick different targets

crystals.name: Mortar Jade
crystals.text: Arcing lob over cover; elements land as zones

crystals.name: Bloatstone
crystals.text: Bigger, slower, +30% power. With Swiftquartz the size and speed cancel and only power stays

crystals.name: Needlepoint
crystals.text: Smaller, faster, +25% critical chance

crystals.name: Nova Pearl
crystals.text: Explodes on impact; blast type from the elements upstream

crystals.name: Lingerite
crystals.text: Leaves a lasting zone where it lands

crystals.name: Thriftstone
crystals.text: -30% drain; in the root socket also -1 Heat

crystals.name: Wellspring Aquamarine
crystals.text: +50% recharge

crystals.name: Siphon Jet
crystals.text: 30% of damage dealt refills the wand

crystals.name: Resonator
crystals.text: Feedback: sends 40% of the shot back to the root to run again; each loop adds 1 Heat

crystals.name: Catalyst
crystals.text: Adjacent reactions twice as strong; elements within 2 sockets also react

crystals.name: Inverter
crystals.text: Reverses the order of every crystal downstream of it

crystals.name: Null Stone
crystals.text: Blank spacer: stops two crystals from reacting

crystals.name: Dampener
crystals.text: -1 Heat; feedback loops capped at 1 and their Heat halved
